Alger, 5 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 5, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — OpenAI has announced the launch of its new artificial intelligence model named GPT-6 Astra. This system stands out for its enhanced performance in security, computing, and the execution of complex tasks.
Des performances de pointe sur les tâche: Cutting-edge performance on complex and scientific tasks
OpenAI a dévoilé GPT-6 Astra, présenté c: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-6 Astra, presented as its most intelligent and aligned model to date. This system builds on advancements in pre-training, reinforcement learning, and alignment. It demonstrates unprecedented capabilities in computer use, web browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, and scientific research.
Sur le plan des performances, la nouvell: In terms of performance, the new technology excels across several benchmark tests. It achieves a score of 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4 and reaches 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3. Additionally, it boasts a 100% success rate on the ExploitBench benchmark.
Pour la recherche scientifique sur Termi: For scientific research on Terminal-Bench Science 0.1, the model achieves a resolution rate of 64.6%. This performance surpasses that of Claude Fable 5.1, which stands at 52.6%, while reducing the estimated API cost by 31%.
Le modèle intègre des améliorations sign: The model integrates significant improvements in understanding user intent. A test inspired by the Hugging Face incident evaluates whether the model exceeds its authorized boundaries when faced with an impossible task. On this evaluation, GPT-6 Astra records a boundary-crossing rate of 0%. For comparison, the previous model GPT-5.6 Sol breached this limit in 48% of cases.
Greg Kamradt, de la fondation ARC Prize,: Greg Kamradt, from the ARC Prize foundation, points out that the model achieves human parity on this benchmark. The system surpasses the human efficiency threshold on 96% of the ARC-AGI-3 test levels.
Le déploiement de GPT-6 Astra débute imm: The rollout of GPT-6 Astra begins immediately for a select group of organizations. It will be progressively accessible to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers. The technology will also be available via the OpenAI API, Microsoft Azure, and AWS Bedrock.
